summary: BL-009 rich content, bounded local diagrams and linked Information: 126 automated checks and 37 combined browser checks passed, plus one built-Worker rendering check. TypeScript and Worker build passed.

renderers.mermaid: Wonderworks Mermaid core v1; documented finite subset with Dagre 3.1.1

limitations: Mermaid supports the documented core subset, not every Mermaid extension. Unsupported source is preserved and reported by block; submission validates supported syntax and complexity.
Runtime renderer unavailability and timeouts retain source fallbacks. No source is sent to an external rendering service.
Checks use disposable loopback projects and emulated local identity. Hosted OAuth expiry/revocation is not certified by these checks.
Sites tracks publication separately. This release does not change lifecycle policy or fabricate verification.

checks.title: Author requirements with measurable acceptance criteria
checks.detail: UI and MCP preserve exact body source, explicit formats, optional diagrams, normative criteria and proposal-only saves. A 50000-code-point emoji body survived HTTP staging; one extra character was rejected without a save.

checks.title: Track meaningful requirement revisions
checks.detail: Domain/API tests verified source-whitespace differences, all new fields, base-relative revisions, normalized no-ops, restoration, history and atomic reviewed Apply.

checks.title: Delete requirements without breaking references
checks.detail: Final-set tests reject target deletion while dependencies, Sources or mappings remain; atomic removal of a summary and source succeeds. Frozen/history records are retained.

checks.title: Summarize project size and readiness
checks.detail: Browser checks verified ten requirements plus one Information item leave readiness at 100%; normative counts are separate and evidence target validation excludes Information.

checks.title: Maintain valid acyclic requirement dependencies
checks.detail: Shared reference checks reject information dependency targets and preserve cycle checks. Sources/mappings do not become dependency edges.

checks.title: Export the current specification for implementation
checks.detail: Exports preserve exact body in safe fences, explicit kinds/formats, diagrams, alternatives, mappings, Sources revisions and freshness, with external-viewer guidance.

checks.title: Read current requirements and frozen implementation context through MCP
checks.detail: Independent authenticated MCP clients verified complete pagination, kinds, status/search filters, exact current/proposal/history/snapshot fields and immutable frozen reads.

checks.title: Draft requirement changesets through MCP
checks.detail: Both ten-source MCP batches resolve forward client references in Sources/mappings; invalid final references and stale writes persist no IDs or partial changes.

checks.title: Store explicit content formats and preserve editable source
checks.detail: All three formats preserve Unicode, whitespace, entities and fences. Unit and HTTP boundary checks enforce the shared 50000-code-point limit without trimming.

checks.title: Edit source and render rich content consistently
checks.detail: Browser tests verified Source/Preview, caret restoration, format switching, tables/emphasis/code, literal plain text, dirty live refresh, saved details, review and snapshots.

checks.title: Author and render Mermaid and Graphviz diagrams
checks.detail: Browser and built-Worker checks rendered flowchart, sequence and state fixtures plus directed, undirected and grouped DOT. Ordered blocks, alternatives, source and scale controls passed.

checks.title: Contain unsafe content and recover from rendering failures
checks.detail: HTML/SVG attack fixtures execute no code or external requests. Source survives unsupported syntax, unavailable workers, timeout and stale responses. Submission identifies item/block errors. SVG cache reuse is sanitized.

checks.title: Add non-normative information elements to specifications
checks.detail: UI and MCP create Information without normative placeholder criteria/parameters/dependencies. Ten-source navigation and separate counts/readiness/evidence targeting passed.

checks.title: Link information elements to the requirements they summarize
checks.detail: Ten source and reverse links navigate within proposal/current/frozen contexts. Structured mappings resolve batch references; duplicate/missing/wrong-kind targets and unresolved source removal are rejected.

checks.title: Show when a summary needs review after source changes
checks.detail: Changed sources produce Needs review without rewriting summaries; explicit proposed review advances markers. Final-revision validation and frozen old markers were verified.

checks.title: Review rich content and information changes as versioned source
checks.detail: Rich before/after renders and exact field diffs, history, whitespace revisions, restore and rebase conflicts passed. Real D1 rollback and restart retained source, references and receipts.

checks.title: Find and inspect requirements and information by content
checks.detail: Kind/search/status/tag combinations share one predicate. Browser source navigation, separate metrics, Information filtering and compact keyboard editing passed.

checks.title: Preserve rich content and summary context in snapshots and exports
checks.detail: Frozen JSON reads remain exact; legacy field absence survives import/export. Rich imports cannot silently clear fields. Markdown exports include exact source, labels and review context.

checks.title: Read and stage rich content and information through MCP
checks.detail: Separate browser-closed clients staged, read and submitted ten-source examples in both diagram languages, with exact source, complete pagination and field-preserving legacy edits.

checks.title: Verify rich content and ten-requirement diagram summaries
checks.detail: 126 automated checks, 37 combined browser checks, and one built-Worker browser execution passed with no failures/skips. TypeScript and Worker build passed.
